Shopify Store Optimizer skill, initial release:

- Audits Shopify stores end-to-end and produces a prioritized fix list to optimize conversion rate, AOV, and SEO.

- Triggered by common Shopify optimization and audit requests.
- Delivers actionable, ranked recommendations with expected lift and effort estimates.
